name: Gelbin Mekkatorque
summary: In Tinker Town, Gelbin Mekkatorque leads the gnomes who live in exile in Ironforge. His inventions include the mechanostrider and the Deeprun Tram, and he guides the effort to reclaim Gnomeregan.

sections.title: The High Tinker and Master Inventor
sections.body: Gelbin Mekkatorque earned the title of High Tinker through inventive skill. Among the gnomes, leadership rests on intellect and merit, not bloodlines. He built the first working mechanostrider, changing how gnomes travel. He also helped the Bronzebeard dwarves develop siege engines and played a key part in building the Deeprun Tram between Ironforge and Stormwind.

sections.title: Betrayal and Exile in Ironforge
sections.body:
Troggs rose from deep below and invaded Gnomeregan. At the urging of his trusted friend and chief advisor, Mekgineer Thermaplugg, Gelbin Mekkatorque ordered radioactive waste released into the lower corridors to kill the attackers. Instead, the gas killed thousands of innocent gnomes and mutated the survivors. Thermaplugg took the ruined city.

Mekkatorque led the surviving refugees across Dun Morogh to Ironforge, burdened by guilt and determined to set things right. King Magni welcomed them in Tinker Town. There, Mekkatorque directs gnomekind’s military and scientific efforts toward reclaiming Gnomeregan.

faq.answer: Gelbin Mekkatorque leads the gnomes as their elected High Tinker. A master engineer, he designed important inventions, including the mechanostrider and the Deeprun Tram.

faq.q: Why is Mekkatorque in Ironforge instead of Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Troggs overran Gnomeregan, and radioactive fallout devastated the city. Mekkatorque led his people across Dun Morogh to Ironforge, where King Magni Bronzebeard gave them refuge in Tinker Town as they plan to reclaim their home.

faq.q: What caused the catastrophe in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Mekkatorque’s trusted advisor persuaded him to release toxic radioactive coolant into Gnomeregan’s lower chambers to stop the troggs. The gas failed to halt them and instead irradiated the city, killing thousands of gnomes.

faq.q: What did Mekkatorque invent before becoming High Tinker?
faq.answer: Before becoming High Tinker, Mekkatorque invented the mechanostrider. He also helped develop the dwarven siege engine and played a key part in creating the Deeprun Tram between Ironforge and Stormwind.
Gnomes have no hereditary monarchy. They elect a High Tinker based on merit and intellect, and Mekkatorque’s authority comes from that election.

angles.text: As a gnome, you look to Mekkatorque as your people’s leader in exile. His guilt over Gnomeregan’s poisoning weighs on him, while his brilliance and devotion to reclaiming your ancestral home command loyalty in Tinker Town.
Before you stands the High Tinker, inventor of the mechanostrider and a driving mind behind the Deeprun Tram. His Tinker Town workshop carries forward gnomish engineering.
